name: Electronic Specialties of Ct
old_description: Exceptional Manufacturer of Printed Circuit Board Assembly Solutions
about:
Electronic Specialties of Connecticut, Inc. (ESC) operates from a 14,500-square-foot, climate-controlled facility in Hamden, Connecticut. The company was established in 1981 by Rich Dumont. In 2012, Duc Nguyen, who had purchased the business with a partner, became the sole owner and has directed operations since.

ESC specializes in printed circuit board assembly, handling through-hole, surface-mount, and mixed-technology builds from prototype through full production. Its high-speed Juki pick-and-place lines can place up to 60,000 components per hour, supported by a Speedline OmniMax ten-zone reflow oven, a full aqueous cleaning line, and wave soldering for both RoHS and non-RoHS runs. The shop also provides automated optical inspection (Mirtec MV-3 and MVHTL systems), manual X-ray inspection (QUADRA3 PRO), functional testing, value-added unit assembly (cable harnesses, sheet-metal and plastic integration), box-build, design and layout services, and materials management for turnkey or consigned programs.

The company serves the broader electronics industry, working with customers who need prototype quantities as well as volume production runs. It accepts both full turnkey and consigned-material arrangements and uses an MRP system to coordinate component procurement from multiple vendors.

ESC states that its mission is to exceed customer expectations for quality, service, technology, and cost while maintaining a safe, healthy workplace. It emphasizes the use of current automation and IPC-certified processes (IPC-A-610, J-STD-001) to deliver reliable assemblies and offers design input aimed at maximizing production efficiency and reducing cost.

name: Element Materials Technology Wilmington (Formerly SL Pharma Labs Inc. )
old_description: It was in the late 20th century (1997) that SL Pharma Labs started providing its clients with its high-quality service. On the one hand, we aimed at offering a top-quality pharmaceutical product. On the other one, we ensured the testing of topical, liquid, and parenteral drugs. The entire process covered several development directions (formulation, analytical, microbiological) along with clinical manufacturing in the early stages.
about:
Element Materials Technology Wilmington, formerly known as SL Pharma Labs Inc., operates from Wilmington, Delaware. The business was established in 1997 with a focus on providing high-quality pharmaceutical services, including the testing of topical, liquid, and parenteral drug products across formulation, analytical, and microbiological development, as well as early-stage clinical manufacturing.

Today the company delivers a broad range of contract CMC services covering pre-formulation and formulation development, analytical and microbiological quality control testing, parenteral and topical product development with clinical manufacturing, ICH stability studies, technical transfers, and regulatory documentation support for ANDA, NDA, and IND submissions. It also offers consulting services to clients ranging from start-ups to multinational corporations.

The client base spans the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors, including both large and small organizations in the United States and Canada. Notable collaborations have included technology transfer projects with My Canadian Pharmacy and with Charles W. Newhall of Pharmoscorp.com, supporting commercial production scale-up.

The firm emphasizes five core differentiators: deep industry experience, a customized adaptive approach, commitment to meeting deadlines and budgets, end-to-end project ownership, and continuous GMP-compliance tracking throughout every stage of development and manufacturing.

name: Elevate Packaging
old_description: Elevate Packaging is the leading provider of compostable packaging and labels. Our exclusive PURE Labels™ are the first and only certified compostable label in North America. With our bags, pouches, and labels, we offer a complete one-stop compostable packaging solution for sustainable business.
about:
Elevate Packaging is based in Chicago, Illinois. Founded in 2000 by Rich Cohen, a former corporate strategist and computer scientist at a Fortune 500 company, the business began after a 1999 sabbatical during which Cohen encountered tree-free papers made from invasive plant species. He launched the company to address the lack of viable compostable packaging alternatives.

The company develops and manufactures a full line of compostable packaging, including stand-up pouches (kraft, white, and transparent), flat pouches, cellophane bags, coffee bags, poly mailers, adhesive labels and stickers, packaging tape, and gloves. It offers custom design and full-color printing on compostable substrates, and operates a take-back program with the Compost Stewardship Institute to ensure used packaging is composted. The product catalog spans hundreds of SKUs sold in pack quantities of 100 units.

Elevate serves brands in natural and organic food, institutional food service, coffee and tea, cannabis, apparel, body care, e-commerce, and retail. Its solutions are used for product packaging, shipping supplies, and retail-ready packaging where compostability is required.

Cohen started the business after witnessing plastic pollution in remote wilderness areas. The company’s stated mission is to “Eliminate Plastic Waste and Create a Healthy Planet.” It differentiates itself through early commercialization of certified compostable pressure-sensitive labels (PURE Labels™), BPI-certified materials meeting ASTM D6400, and a circular-economy take-back service.

name: Elevation Foods
old_description: Great food is our reputation. We partner with leading retailers and operators to bring exceptional food concepts to life. We are a passionate team of experts in culinary, R&D, marketing, manufacturing, and sourcing with a track record of innovative food ideas that delight customers, drive growth, and elevate brands.
about:
Elevation Foods operates from its headquarters in Knoxville, Tennessee, with redundant manufacturing facilities in Danvers, Massachusetts, and Boston, Massachusetts. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure.

The company produces a range of prepared foods including savory baked goods such as quiches, frittatas, and chicken pot pies, as well as dips and spreads, deli salads, and sous vide potatoes. Its capabilities span kettle cooking, baking, mixing, and filling across both refrigerated and frozen formats, with packaging options from single-serve retail to bulk foodservice sizes. Two USDA-inspected plants provide redundant capacity for national and regional distribution.

Elevation Foods serves foodservice operators and retail channels, including grocery and club retailers. It offers contract manufacturing and private label services, developing custom products for foodservice menus and scaling existing recipes for production. Customers range from deli and sandwich bars to hot bar operators seeking labor-saving, consistent prepared foods.

The company emphasizes a collaborative, culinary-led approach, positioning its R&D and commercialization teams as partners to bring client concepts to shelf. Redundant facilities are cited as a differentiator for supply reliability.

old_description: Since 2016, Elite Medical Care has been a family-owned, full-service durable medical equipment (DME) provider. We operate across all of Arkansas and half of Mississippi. We specialize in comprehensive respiratory therapy, offering equipment such as invasive and noninvasive ventilators, Trilogy machines for COPD, tracheostomy care, oxygen systems, and CPAPs/BiPAPs.
about:
Elite Medical Care was founded in 2016 in Mabelvale, Arkansas, as a family-owned, full-service durable medical equipment provider. The company began with a focus on respiratory therapy and has expanded to serve all of Arkansas and roughly half of Mississippi.

The company supplies a range of respiratory and mobility equipment, including invasive and noninvasive ventilators, Philips Trilogy machines for COPD, oxygen systems, CPAP and BiPAP devices, tracheostomy supplies, hospital beds, and wheelchairs. Its staff includes licensed respiratory therapists who handle equipment setup, patient education, and ongoing clinical support. Operations emphasize rapid deployment, with same-day delivery available for urgent needs.

Elite Medical Care serves home-healthcare patients, long-term-care facilities, and hospice providers. Nursing centers and hospice organizations in Arkansas and Mississippi rely on the company for timely equipment delivery and clinical coordination; testimonials cite partnerships with a local nursing center, a hospice administrator, and a community health provider.

The founders aimed to combine equipment supply with hands-on, compassionate support so patients can recover at home.

name: Elite Printing and Packaging, Inc
old_description: At Elite, we blend craftsmanship, efficiency, and uncompromising attention to detail to help brands scale with confidence. Every pouch, label, and shipment that leaves our facility reflects your best. As a tight-knit, experienced team, we provide clear communication, flexible solutions, and partnership you can trust—treating your business like our own.
about:
Elite Printing and Packaging, Inc. operates from Hazelwood, Missouri, in the St. Louis metropolitan area. The company is family-owned and describes itself as a tight-knit, experienced team focused on craftsmanship and attention to detail.

The company provides a full spectrum of packaging services under one roof: custom printing via digital and rotogravure presses for flexible films, labels, shrink sleeves, tamper bands, and retail cartons; conversion of those materials into stand-up, gusseted, flat, and pillow pouches, sachets, jars, tubes, and canisters, including eco-friendly recyclable and compostable options; co-packing using vertical form-fill-seal (VFFS) machines, flow wrappers, and carousel fillers for pet treats, human snacks, powders, and liquid products; and fulfillment covering e-commerce and retail pick-and-pack, POS assembly, lot-tracked warehousing, and daily LTL/FTL and parcel shipping. Runs range from small batches to high-volume production.

Elite serves brands in the pet-food, human-food, and specialty-food sectors, as well as e-commerce and retail distributors. Concrete examples include co-packing pet treats and snacks, flow-wrapping powder products, and filling jars and tubes for food brands.

The company emphasizes its all-in-one model, traceable lot control and quality assurance at every step, fast turnaround with flexible order minimums, and a family-owned, detail-driven culture as its primary differentiators.

old_description: is an industry leading spice importer and custom manufacturer offering an extensive line of spices, seasonings and specialty food ingredients.  American owned and operated, with six separate state-of-the-art facilities on the East and West coasts, Elite’s focus on food safety is uncompromising.  With a reputation for exceptional quality, superior R&D capabilities, experienced technical support and outstanding customer service, Elite Spice is prepared to meet the needs of all segments of the commercial food industry.
about:
Elite Spice Inc was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Sparks, Nevada, with a corporate office in Jessup, Maryland. The company is privately held and American-owned, operating six facilities across the East and West coasts.

The company imports spices and operates as a custom manufacturer, producing pure spices, custom blended seasonings, capsicum products, onion and garlic ingredients, dehydrated fruits and vegetables, and other specialty food ingredients. Its manufacturing operations include cleaning, milling, blending, packaging, and proprietary microbial reduction and pathogen elimination systems. A culinary innovation center and multiple research and development laboratories support product development. The company reports 14 employees at its headquarters.

Elite Spice serves all segments of the commercial food industry, supplying ingredients that flavor some of the world's most popular food brands. Its customers include food manufacturers across various categories.

The company emphasizes food safety and purity, marketing its products as "Processed in the USA." It maintains direct control over manufacturing, from raw material treatment through packaging, and operates fully equipped quality assurance laboratories to verify compliance with U.S. federal regulations.

name: Ellerbuilt Woodworks
old_description: Driven by a deep respect for the creative process and an unwavering commitment to doing what is right, Ellerbuilt was founded on a simple, powerful idea: if you are going to spend your life creating, you should pour everything you have into it. Every table, every project, every piece is the result of patience, purpose, and an artist’s relentless pursuit of excellence — even when no one is watching.
about:
Ellerbuilt Woodworks operates from Carson City, Nevada, where founder Brandon Eller established the shop as an extension of a lifelong dedication to woodworking. Eller’s path began with childhood projects — refinishing a bench at age ten — and deepened through study of Japanese joinery traditions. The business emerged from a philosophy that craftsmanship should reflect the maker’s full attention, not merely fill a space.

The shop produces custom cabinetry and handcrafted furniture for residential interiors. Offerings span kitchen and bathroom cabinets, built-in shelving and wall units, home-office desks and partner desks, bedroom pieces such as headboards and dressers, plus kitchen islands, bar cabinets, and entertainment centers. Work combines traditional hand-tool techniques with modern machinery, and finishes include conversion varnish, catalyzed lacquer, and UV-cured coatings. Wood selection ranges from domestic hardwoods — oak, maple, cherry, walnut — to softwoods like redwood and cedar and exotic species.

Clients are homeowners, designers, and builders seeking made-to-measure woodwork for kitchens, baths, offices, bedrooms, and entertainment areas. Each project starts with a site visit and design consultation, followed by a detailed timeline; smaller jobs may finish in weeks, while larger commissions can require several months.

Ellerbuilt distinguishes itself through an uncompromising standard: “If something is easy to do, it’s not worth doing.” Eller visits every installation space, designs for exact fit, and insists on joinery and finishing that will endure generations. The shop’s differentiator is not speed or volume but the deliberate, risk-accepting pursuit of pieces that carry the maker’s signature.

name: Ellis Fabrics
old_description: Ellis Fabrics in Bentonville, Arkansas, offers a wide selection of quality, affordable upholstery and home décor fabrics and trims, as well as customer service that can’t be beat. We encourage you to come in, browse, and ask any questions you may have. We love to talk with our customers about their projects!
about:
Ellis Fabrics operates in Bentonville, Arkansas, as the retail arm of Joe Ellis Upholstery. Joe Ellis began upholstering in 2002, working with independent shops in Arkansas and Louisiana. He opened Joe Ellis Upholstery in 2008, and the business grew to a larger space within five years. In 2013, Ellis and his mother, Cheryl, added a fabric store to answer frequent customer requests for fabric sources. The company remains privately held, with Ellis as owner and his mother involved in the expansion.

The business runs two workrooms staffed by nine full-time professionals plus part-time help, producing custom upholstery for residential, commercial, and specialty markets. In addition to fabrication, Ellis Fabrics stocks a range of upholstery and home décor fabrics, trims, real and faux leather, outdoor fabrics, and specialty designer materials available for special order. A design center offers in-person consultation for fabric selection and durability guidance. The shop also provides pick-up and delivery service across Northwest Arkansas, Northeast Oklahoma, and Southwest Missouri.

Customers span residential clients, hospitality venues such as restaurants, bars, museums, and hotels, medical and fitness facilities, and RV or motorhome owners. Notable accounts include the Roark Group (design/fabrication), Onyx Coffee Lab (hospitality), Laura's Draperies & Blinds (window treatments), and various interior designers and architects across Arkansas and beyond.

The company emphasizes a full-service experience from consultation to finished piece, summarized by the tagline “If you can dream it, we can upholster it.” Clients cite swift communication, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to meet tight timelines on highly custom projects as distinguishing factors.

name: ElringKlinger Manufacturing Indiana Inc.
old_description: ElringKlinger ist ein weltweit führender Systempartner der Automobilindustrie für Elektromobilität, Leichtbaulösungen, Dichtungs- und Abschirmtechnik sowie Werkzeugtechnologie. Wir gestalten die Mobilität von heute und morgen aktiv mit. Auch im Non-Automotive-Bereich wachsen wir erfolgreich weiter.
about:
ElringKlinger Manufacturing Indiana Inc. operates in Fort Wayne, Indiana, as part of the global ElringKlinger Group, a German-headquartered automotive supplier listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (ISIN DE). The Indiana entity serves as a manufacturing arm for the group's portfolio of sealing, shielding, lightweight, and electrification technologies.

The facility produces components for all vehicle drive types—combustion, hybrid, and fully electric. Core product lines include cylinder-head and specialty gaskets, thermal and acoustic shielding, formed metal parts, and assembled modules such as lithium-ion battery systems and fuel-cell stacks. The group also maintains a dedicated toolmaking technology center in Lenningen, Germany, supporting global production. Scale specifics for the Indiana site—square footage, headcount, annual volume—are not disclosed in the source material.

Primary customers are automotive OEMs and tier-one suppliers across passenger-car and commercial-vehicle segments. The company also supplies non-automotive sectors, leveraging its sealing, shielding, and lightweighting expertise for industrial applications. Concrete examples from the group's portfolio include electric drive units, underbody systems, chassis and brake components, and aftermarket repair kits sold under the "Elring – das Original" brand.

ElringKlinger positions itself as an independent, globally networked system partner that combines technological depth with a sustainability agenda aimed at decarbonizing mobility. The group's SHAPE30 strategy emphasizes CO2 reduction, energy efficiency, and the development of hydrogen and battery-electric solutions as key differentiators.
